message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. Facts: He signed a rental agreement with car owner, then fraudulently pretended to be the owner and signed a rental agreement with another person, collected rent and deposit, and refused to return. This is contract fraud (合同诈骗). Also possibly fraud (诈骗) but guidelines: when deceptive contract terms and intent to defraud through contract, classify as 合同诈骗 rather than generic 诈骗. So charge: 合同诈骗. Any other? He also maybe misappropriated deposit? That's part of contract fraud. Not other categories. So answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>. Need JSON with reasoning and final_answer.
